resources.string: Sounds, snooze, Pomodoro, working hours and history
No alarms yet. Add one with the button below.
No timers running. Start one from a preset above, or from the keyboard\'s Clock tool.
No cities yet. Add the places of the people you talk to.
Alarms, timers, stopwatch, world clocks, meeting planner, date maths, countdowns and history
For alarms you can rely on

An alarm needs three things from Android to ring at the exact minute, over the lock screen, with buttons to snooze and dismiss. Each row here is one that is still missing. Alarms ring without them too, only less exactly, or as a plain notification. After the phone restarts, the alarms are set again when the keyboard first starts.
Without it, Android can ring an alarm some minutes late
Without it, a ringing alarm shows only as a notification on the lock screen
For Snooze and Dismiss in the shade, and for running timers
How the clock tool writes the hours. Like the phone follows the phone\'s own setting. 12-hour writes 3:00 PM. 24-hour writes 15:00.
On the big clock and on the clock faces
Shows the seconds on the big clock and on the clock faces. Turn this off for a calmer clock that changes once a minute.
Show the world clocks two to a row, so more fit in the panel
Shows the world clocks two to a row. More cities then fit in the panel without a scroll, and each one is drawn smaller.
List the world clocks with the earliest time first, instead of in the order you added them
Lists the world clocks in order of their time, earliest first. With this off, the cities stay in the order you added them.
A hold on your own clock types this one at once, and a hold on a city offers it first
The format in which a time is typed into your text. A hold on your own clock types the time in this format at once. A hold on a city shows this format first in its list.
These apply to every alarm. An alarm can keep its own snooze length, set in its editor, and can be kept from vibrating.
Alarms and timers ring through Android\'s alarm notification. Pick its sound and vibration on Android\'s settings page for it.
While an alarm or a timer rings

The phone vibrates while an alarm or a timer rings, together with the sound. This helps when the phone is in a pocket or the volume is low. Off, nothing vibrates; on, a single alarm can still be kept from vibrating in its editor.
How long an alarm stays quiet after you press Snooze, before it rings again.
An alarm starts quiet and gets louder over this time. Timers always ring at full volume.
An alarm starts quiet and gets louder over this time, for a gentler wake-up. At zero the alarm starts at full volume. Timers always ring at full volume.
An alarm nobody answers stops by itself and shows as missed in the history
An alarm that nobody answers stops ringing by itself after this time. It is then listed as missed in the history.
Your phone\'s own time ahead of the cities
Puts your phone\'s own time at the top of the world clocks, before the cities.
UTC ahead of the cities, after local time
Puts UTC near the top of the world clocks, after your local time and before the cities. This is useful if you work with times given in UTC.
An alarm that stops ringing by itself snoozes instead, up to this many times or until someone answers, before it counts as missed
An alarm that stops by itself snoozes and rings again, this many times at most. If nobody answers after the last time, it counts as missed. At zero, an alarm that stops by itself is missed at once.
An alarm. Tap to answer it
A timer. Tap to answer it
Shows the next alarm in the notifications this long before it rings, with a button to skip it

Shows a notification this long before an alarm rings. The notification names the alarm and has a button to skip it, for the days you wake up before it. Always keeps the next alarm in the notifications from the moment you set it, with its day and time, the way alarm apps do, so you can see an alarm is set without opening the clock.
Shows a snoozed alarm in the notifications, with a button to end the snooze
While an alarm is snoozed, a notification shows when it rings again. Its button ends the snooze, so the alarm does not ring a second time.
Leaves a notification when an alarm rang with nobody to answer it
Leaves a notification when an alarm rang and nobody answered it, so you know that it rang.
On the ring screen. When off, the volume keys do nothing there.
On the screen of a ringing alarm, a press on a volume key snoozes the alarm. With this off, the volume keys do nothing on that screen, so a press by accident cannot snooze it.
A Pomodoro run is a focus time, then a short break, again and again, with a long break after some focus times. Each phase starts by itself when the one before ends.
The length of one focus period of the Pomodoro timer. A common length is 25 minutes.
The length of the short break between two focus periods of the Pomodoro timer.
The length of the long break that the Pomodoro timer gives after several focus periods.
How many focus periods pass before the Pomodoro timer gives a long break instead of a short one.
The planner shades these hours as working hours in every city on your list, and finds the times when they all overlap.
The hour a working day starts. The meeting planner shades the hours from here to Work ends as working hours in every city on your list, and finds the times when they all overlap.
The hour a working day ends. The meeting planner shades the hours from Work starts to here as working hours in every city on your list, and finds the times when they all overlap.
How long the clock keeps its history of alarms and timers that rang. Older records are deleted. Always keeps them until you delete them yourself.
